_about: Reviewed exceptions for tools/privacy-scan.mjs. Each entry: rule (or *), path (glob over repo-relative paths), optional match (a regex the matched text must satisfy) and why. forbidden-path can never be allowed. private-term only on one reviewed line: an exact path plus line_sha256 (the lineHash of a --json report), never a glob or a match, so the term itself is never written here; any edit to that line brings the finding back. Keep entries narrow; the scan lists any entry that no longer matches anything. repository: the public repository (owner/name); links to the same owner's other repositories are reported (rule other-repo).
